notes: Corrected one unit: the italic any of is now its own added unit rather than a supplied determiner inside פְּלִיטֵי's unit. Rule 15's supplied determiner stands where an a or a the would stand before a noun with no determiner of its own, and here the ASV writes a supplied the of its own after any, so the partitive quantifier and its of answer to no morpheme; they stand together and do one office, so they form one added unit (rules 2, 30, 33), headed on any.
The construct noun keeps the supplied the under rule 29 and heads on fugitives (rules 24, 31); the chain's of is אֶפְרַיִם's under rule 19.

Everything else stands: the marginal Or, toward Ephraim is read and set aside (rule 38); הָיָה takes it was so that because the that stands inside the frame ahead of the כִּי clause, which leaves the apodosis waw unrepresented (rule 45); and the interrogative particle takes the fronted Art while אַתָּה keeps only thou (rules 17, 20).
